user_saw: Telegram private-chat messages arrived without the requested effect and no error was shown.
summary: The fix forwards a numeric effect ID to Telegram on the first accepted message of a private-chat send.
reasoning: The shared effectId option predates the shallow history boundary, and the available Telegram history showed no earlier forwarding of that option. The apparent removal of message_effect_id was from a type declaration whose send-context field list already omitted it. The offline history could not establish when Telegram first accepted the shared option or whether it ever delivered the requested effect before this fix.
